exclusions.meta.submissionIds: a steered prompt's submission id is drawn by each side; the count and non-empty ids are compared
exclusions.meta.transcript.messageId / attemptId /: the client turn carried Node's (turnMeta); the core draws its own, so both sides are compared as an id (a non-empty string)
exclusions.restored row id: Node counts hist_<session>_<n>, the core uses the record's iid; both sides are compared as an id

keptWhole: per case: the prompt(s), the applied names, every stored user row, every restored user row

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

syntheticInputs: the provider: one that answers "Done." (a summary request: "a summary of the conversation") and calls no tool
the skills: three SKILL.md files under MIXDOG_DATA_DIR/skills; broken-guide's file is removed before its case
each prompt's transcriptMeta, as a client turn carries it: { messageId (msg_turn, msg_<n>), attemptId, checkpointId, at: 1000, device: "desktop-1", completionVerb: "Mapped" }
